title: RPIQ: Residual-Projected Multi-Collaboration Closed-Loop and Single Instance Quantization for Visually Impaired Assistance
selection_reason: RPIQ applies closed-loop quantization to LLM/VLM weights and reports substantial peak-memory reduction for deployment; the assistive application is not the sole basis for relevance.
